name: @corbits-builder/designer-plugin
description: Designs how the app could look, as mockups the person compares, tries and approves, and lets the person choose its fonts and colours.
author: Sawyer Cutler <sawyer@dirtroad.dev>

builder.when: The person wants to see how the app could look, to try or approve a design, or to choose the app's fonts or colours.
builder.unless: They want the built app itself changed in a way they already stated exactly.

mockup.when: The person wants to see how the app could look: a mockup, design options to compare, or another pass on a design option.
mockup.unless: They want the built app itself changed, or to pick fonts or colours on a screen.

review.when: The design is ready for the person to look at, or needs their approval.
review.unless: The person only asked a question about the design.

choose.when: Several design concepts are filed and the person is to pick the one they want.
choose.unless: Only one design is filed, which review shows, or the person only asked a question about the designs.

pick-fonts.when: The person is unhappy with the typeface or unsure which font would suit.
pick-fonts.unless: They already said exactly which font they want, or they want text bigger or smaller, or a whole new look.

pick-colours.when: The person is unhappy with the colours or unsure which colours would suit the brand or the background.
pick-colours.unless: They already said exactly which colour they want, or they want another font, bigger or smaller text, or a whole new look.

examples: make me a mockup for a dog-walking app
show me a few different looks
can I see what it would look like
I want to give feedback on the design
the design looks good, approve it
can we use a different typeface
I'm not sure about the font, what else could work
the writing looks boring, can it be more elegant
make it look like a newspaper with a serif
can we make it less orange
I don't know which colour would suit us

facts.design_chosen: the person chose a design from the design options
